remarks: Welcome to 1152 Shippan Avenue, Apartment #2 - an updated  2-bedroom and extra space for office , 3-bathroom. Unit located at Stamford's desirable Shippan neighborhood. This bright and inviting second floor apartment offers a flexible layout, generous living space. Each bedroom features its own private bathroom, plus there's an additional full bath. Enjoy the convenience of being just minutes from vibrant downtown Stamford, local restaurants, shopping, and nightlife. Take a stroll to Shippan Point, enjoy a relaxing day at Cove Island Park, or explore the scenic walking trails along the water. Commuters will appreciate easy access to I-95 and the Metro-North station. Live close to everything Stamford has to offer - beaches, parks, marinas, and a bustling city vibe - while enjoying the comfort of a residential neighborhood. Don't miss this fantastic rental opportunity in a prime location! 1 Parking assigned
